hints.title: Suffix Shared Substring
hints.text: Words whose suffix matches another longer word can share the same terminal reference.

hints.title: Deduplicating Suffixes
hints.text: For each word in the set, remove all of its proper suffixes from candidate roots.

hints.title: Accumulate Encoded Lengths
hints.text: Initialize a set with all words. For every word, discard word[1:], word[2:], and so on. Sum the length of remaining words plus one for each trailing hash tag.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Suffix elimination via hash set discard.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise string suffix comparisons take O(N^2 * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set stores distinct candidate root words in O(sum(L)) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use reversed-trie insertion or suffix deletion via hash set.
